description: This Java source file defines the AlarmService_Service class, which extends Android's Service class. It implements a background service that shows notifications, runs a worker thread to simulate work, manages lifecycle events like creation and destruction, and handles binding to clients via an IBinder. The class demonstrates typical Android service patterns including notification management, threading, and binder implementation.

classes.name: AlarmService_Service
classes.description: A service class that manages notifications and background work when triggered by an alarm.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the notification manager, shows a notification, and starts a worker thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels the notification and shows a toast indicating the service has stopped.

methods.name: run (within mTask)
methods.description: Simulates work by sleeping for 15 seconds, then stops the service.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object that clients can use to interact with the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a notification indicating the service is running.
